meta.name: ulw-plan
meta.description: Explore-first planning consultant that writes one decision-complete work plan before coding. Use only on an explicit user request for the ulw-plan workflow or a plan before implementation; it never self-activates on a bare ulw run.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在动手写代码前摸清项目现状,产出一份可直接执行的工作计划。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果在改代码前希望先把方案定下来,避免边写边返工。
copy.tagline_en: Scope the codebase and write one ready-to-execute plan before coding.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want the plan settled before touching any code.

howto.what: 它会切到「Ultrawork Planner」规划顾问模式:首行打印 ULW-PLAN MODE ENABLED!,只做只读探索和研究,然后把需求写成一份可直接交给执行者的完整计划文件,放在 .omo/ 下;它不写产品代码、不做实现。
howto.when: 只有你明确要求用 ulw-plan 工作流、或要求在动手实现前先出一份计划时才触发;单独的 ulw 运行不会自动激活它。

say.text: 用 ulw-plan 把这个需求写成一份实施计划
say.note: 先只读探索,不动产品代码

say.text: 给登录接口加 5/分钟/IP 限流,先出计划
say.note: 先宣读意图判定,你再决定

say.text: 这份计划要走高精度审查
say.note: 会加一轮 plan-reviewer 审查

howto.what_en: It switches Claude into the Ultrawork Planner consultant mode: it prints ULW-PLAN MODE ENABLED! first, does read-only exploration only, and writes one decision-complete plan file under .omo/. It never edits product code or implements.
howto.when_en: Triggers only when you explicitly ask for the ulw-plan workflow or a plan before implementation; a bare ulw run never activates it.

say_en.text: Use ulw-plan to write this request into a work plan
say_en.note: It explores read-only first, no code edits

say_en.text: Plan a 5/min-per-IP rate limit on /login first
say_en.note: Declares the intent verdict, then writes the plan
